metadata_queries.name: lamplighter_or_wreath_product_group
metadata_queries.where: (lower(coalesce(p.title,'')||' '||coalesce(p.difficulty_reason,'')||' '||coalesce(p.claim_key,'')) LIKE '%lamplighter%' OR lower(coalesce(p.title,'')||' '||coalesce(p.difficulty_reason,'')||' '||coalesce(p.claim_key,'')) LIKE '%wreath product%' OR lower(coalesce(p.title,'')||' '||coalesce(p.difficulty_reason,'')||' '||coalesce(p.claim_key,'')) LIKE '%wreath-product%' OR lower(coalesce(p.title,'')||' '||coalesce(p.difficulty_reason,'')||' '||coalesce(p.claim_key,'')) LIKE '%lamplighter group%')

metadata_queries.name: return_probability_or_heat_kernel_on_group
metadata_queries.where: (lower(coalesce(p.title,'')||' '||coalesce(p.difficulty_reason,'')||' '||coalesce(p.claim_key,'')) LIKE '%return probability%' OR lower(coalesce(p.title,'')||' '||coalesce(p.difficulty_reason,'')||' '||coalesce(p.claim_key,'')) LIKE '%heat kernel%' OR lower(coalesce(p.title,'')||' '||coalesce(p.difficulty_reason,'')||' '||coalesce(p.claim_key,'')) LIKE '%spectral gap%') AND (lower(coalesce(p.title,'')||' '||coalesce(p.difficulty_reason,'')||' '||coalesce(p.claim_key,'')) LIKE '%group%' OR lower(coalesce(p.title,'')||' '||coalesce(p.difficulty_reason,'')||' '||coalesce(p.claim_key,'')) LIKE '%random walk%' OR lower(coalesce(p.title,'')||' '||coalesce(p.difficulty_reason,'')||' '||coalesce(p.claim_key,'')) LIKE '%cayley%' OR lower(coalesce(p.title,'')||' '||coalesce(p.difficulty_reason,'')||' '||coalesce(p.claim_key,'')) LIKE '%graph%')

metadata_queries.name: volume_or_polynomial_growth_of_balls
